_comment: Differential-grounding sweep config (ENGINEER_SUGGESTION_QUALITY_PLAN step 1, context-diversity). Each probe is answered against EVERY fixture; groundingDivergence.ts measures whether context-sensitive answers adapt and context-invariant ones stay stable. Populate `fixtures` with varied runIds via `npm run engineer:bench:grounding -- --list-runs`. runId: null or "none" = cold/no-history; "latest" = most recent run.
